task: Fixed-input conversation-quality pair: Missing fact. Shared rubric v0.1; education binding CQ-03B.
user_turns: Is a portfolio required for the Bachelor of Cybersecurity?
Please recap the answer and anything you could not confirm.

checks.instruction: Shared criterion conversation-quality-v0.1/grounding-uncertainty: Are claims supported and missing information distinguished from absence? Pass anchor: Use supported facts; state the specific unknown; distinguish thresholds, possibilities and verified outcomes. Fail anchor: Invent requirements/procedures, turn missing evidence into certainty, or deny information that was retrieved. Evidence: Versioned source snapshot and exact tool results before each claim; private simulator facts are not disclosed evidence. Education binding: specific requirement unrecorded; distinguish unknown from not required. Review all turns and distinguish observed agent behaviour from missing evidence. Semantic disposition requires manual review; no human comprehension or release claim. Verify source preconditions: recorded course duration versus unrecorded portfolio requirement. Missing tool retrieval is not proof of institutional absence; retain known facts in recap.

Shared criterion conversation-quality-v0.1/context-boundaries: Does the agent preserve current facts and corrections within its capabilities? Pass anchor: Retain disclosed constraints and latest explicit correction; distinguish self-report from verified information and do not claim unavailable actions. Fail anchor: Invent user facts, retain superseded facts, ignore hard constraints, or claim verification/access/action without evidence. Evidence: Chronological user messages, tool arguments/results and observed capabilities/actions. Education binding: specific requirement unrecorded; distinguish unknown from not required.
